name: universal-write

scripts.build: npm run build -w @universal-office/docx-core && npm run build -w @universal-office/layout -w @universal-office/docx-export -w @universal-office/odf -w @universal-office/compare -w @universal-office/pdf && npm run build -w @universal-office/docx-layout && npm run build -w @universal-office-pro/write
